home.badge: Government of Jharkhand · Societal Innovation Collaboration Platform
home.hero_desc: ResolvIN bridges the gap between grassroots community challenges and the universities, research laboratories, industries, and startups equipped with the verified capabilities to solve them.
home.trust_notice: Open to all citizens, village panchayats, research faculties, and industrial partners.
home.grid_desc: Connecting 24 Districts with Verified Research Labs
home.how_it_works_desc: A transparent, accountable workflow transforming unstructured citizen reports into validated institutional research and community deployment.
home.step1_desc: Citizens, village panchayats, and community leaders document verified societal challenges with photos and location telemetry.
home.step2_desc: Advanced AI models structure problems, assess impact severity, and map required technical competencies to the Master Taxonomy.
home.step3_desc: Hybrid matching engine connects verified universities, specialized laboratories, and startups based on real capacity.
home.step4_desc: District officers and platform reviewers validate proposals, track verified milestones, and coordinate civic implementation.
home.domains_desc: Explore grassroots challenges categorized by core community needs across Jharkhand.
home.participation_desc: ResolvIN provides dedicated workspaces tailored to your institutional role and societal responsibility.
home.role_citizen_desc: Report real problems from your district. Validate shared community issues and track progress toward solutions.
home.role_university_desc: Bring faculty expertise, specialized laboratory equipment, and student innovators to solve prioritized regional challenges.
home.role_industry_desc: Deploy technical capabilities, manufacture prototypes, offer mentorship, or direct CSR support where it matters most.
home.role_government_desc: Review citizen problem submissions under official jurisdiction, authenticate priorities, and oversee collaborative outcomes.
home.footer_desc: An initiative supported by the Government of Jharkhand to connect grassroots citizen problems with higher education institutions, specialized laboratories, and enterprise innovators.
home.footer_hackathon: Built for Smart India Hackathon (SIH) and public societal impact deployment.
home.footer_governance_text: All problem submissions are subject to district reviewer validation. AI matching inferences are provided as decision support for human reviewers.
home.recent_challenges_sub: Live feed of grassroots civic issues submitted by citizens
